row.team_price_text: Team: from $69/mo billed yearly, flat for 25 users
row.evidence: Zapier's help centre says 'SCIM user provisioning is available only to Enterprise accounts with Workspaces', and the pricing page's comparison table ticks User provisioning (SCIM) only under Enterprise (Contact for pricing).
row.notes: Status unchanged (gated). Pricing page now defaults to yearly billing: Professional from $19.99/mo (1 seat) and Team from $69/mo (25 users), task-tier priced and flat per account, so per-user fields are null. June recorded monthly list prices (Professional $29.99, Team $103.50); the team plan is now Team because Professional has only 1 seat. SAML SSO and audit log (UI) start at Team; SCIM, domain capture and log streams are Enterprise. SCIM needs Enterprise with Workspaces; DELETE deactivates (no hard delete), shared assets go to the owner. No non-SCIM user API. JIT via SAML.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: 1 seat; task-tier priced, not per user.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Flat per account, task-tier priced. Audit log in the Admin Center (UI), no API.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: SCIM needs Enterprise with Workspaces. Log streams push audit events to an HTTPS endpoint (Enterprise); no pull audit-log API documented.

auth.token_source: Settings > User Provisioning (Provision tab): enable, then generate/regenerate token

deprovision.data_retained: Shared Zaps, app connections and folders transfer to the account owner; unshared Zaps are paused. Users cannot be permanently deleted; deactivated users can be reactivated via PATCH/PUT.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, co, sw, gt, ge, lt, le with and/or; POST /Users/.search and /Groups/.search also supported. Not the full SCIM filter DSL.

pagination.notes: startIndex and count; default 50 per page.

rate_limits.text: Rate-limited; 429 returned when limited (no numbers published).

limitations.text: With SCIM enabled, users must be removed from the IdP, not from Zapier's Members page.
Users can only be created in verified domains; userName must equal email.
Only Enterprise accounts with Workspaces; Microsoft AD FS not supported.

scim.notes: Base URL is /scim/v3 while the protocol is SCIM 2.0; request examples on the same page use /scim/v2 paths. The IdP template uses urn:scim:schemas:core:1.0.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Log streams (Enterprise) send audit-log events, including members added, to an HTTPS endpoint; the full event list was not checked.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit log is a UI in the Admin Center (Team and Enterprise); Log streams push the same events to an HTTPS endpoint on Enterprise. No pull API documented.

user_api.notes: No separate user-management REST API is documented; Zapier points to the SCIM API for managing members programmatically. developer docs (docs.zapier.com) cover integrations, MCP and SDK only. Availability false is by absence.

okta.notes: OIN 'Zapier SAML' page ticks SAML, SWA, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate.

onelogin.notes: From Zapier's own guide; OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud guide covers SAML SSO with JIT; no SCIM/identity-management section.
